scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && test -s dist/wp/wrangler.json && ! grep -q AUTH_MODE dist/wp/wrangler.json && grep -q 'rel="manifest"' dist/client/index.html && ! grep -q 'use-credentials' dist/client/index.html && test -d worker && test -d shared && (grep -rEq "(from|import)[ (]*[\"']react" worker shared src/domain src/store; test $? = 1) && (grep -rEq "fetch *\(|indexedDB|XMLHttpRequest|sendBeacon" src/views src/ui src/hooks; test $? = 1)
